Flow.description: SAL-2 Critical Stage Progression Alert. Sends an immediate Orbit Opportunity notification when Opp_Probability__c changes into 75 or 90. Uses Salesforce_Base_URL Custom Label for production-safe record links. Production deployment approved only through governed release process.
Flow.interviewLabel: Notify Critical Stage Progression After Save {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Notify Critical Stage Progression After Save

decisions.description: Exits the Flow without sending if the running user holds the Bypass_Flow custom permission. Prevents unintended sends during data loads and integration runs. Required as the first element inside every record-triggered Flow - CLAUDE.md hard rule.
decisions.label: Check Bypass Permission
decisions.name: Check_Bypass_Permission

recordLookups.description: Retrieves the Opportunity record with cross-object Account.Name and all custom fields needed for the email body. Required because cross-object fields are not always reliably available directly on the trigger record in after-save context. Fields accessed as Get_Opportunity_Detail.FieldApiName in text templates.
recordLookups.label: Get Opportunity Detail
recordLookups.name: Get_Opportunity_Detail

actionCalls.description: Sends the Critical Stage Progression alert to all five fixed recipients when Opp_Probability__c has moved into 75 or 90 from any other value on an update. Plain-text email via emailSimple core action. Fault path captures error message without rethrowing - email failure must not roll back the Opportunity DML. No connector on success - Flow terminates normally after send.
actionCalls.label: Send Critical Stage Alert
actionCalls.name: Send_Critical_Stage_Alert

assignments.description: Fault terminal for the Send Critical Stage Alert action. Captures the fault message into the FaultMessage variable for debugging via Flow Interview debug logs. Does not rethrow the fault - an after-save Flow email failure must not roll back the Opportunity DML. The Opportunity save completes normally when this path is taken. No connector - Flow terminates after capturing the fault message.
assignments.label: Handle Send Fault
assignments.name: Handle_Send_Fault

textTemplates.description: Email subject for the Critical Stage Progression alert. Opp_Probability__c renders the picklist stored value (e.g. 75 or 90) with a literal percent suffix. Uses Opp_Probability__c (custom picklist field) not the standard Probability field - Memory Pack FR-07 NEVER guardrail.
textTemplates.name: Email_Subject

textTemplates.description: Email body for the Critical Stage Progression alert. Contains all 16 payload fields from SAL-2 PRD Section 3.1. Previous Probability uses $Record__Prior.Opp_Probability__c - the native after-save prior-value system variable; no helper field required. Record link uses Opportunity_ID_18__c (CASESAFEID formula, deployed 25 Apr 2026) per Memory Pack FR-06. Record link base URL uses Custom Label Salesforce_Base_URL (OD-02 resolved). MVP: all 16 field rows render unconditionally; blank fields display an empty value. Conditional blank-row suppression is a future enhancement.
textTemplates.name: Email_Body

variables.description: Stores the fault message if the Send Critical Stage Alert action fails. Written by the Handle_Send_Fault assignment element. Visible in Flow Interview debug logs for post-failure investigation. Does not affect Flow execution outcome or the Opportunity record save.
variables.name: FaultMessage
